Plugin proposals are a way to gauge community interest **before** you start
writing code. It also helps maintainers spot overlap with existing work.

## Plugin type

- [ ] File format loader (e.g. Bruker, Asylum, Nanoscope)
- [ ] Polymer model (e.g. FJC, twist-WLC, eWLC variant)
- [ ] Baseline correction
- [ ] Fitting engine backend
- [ ] Other: ___

## What it would do

A short description of the plugin's responsibility and the API it would
expose.

## Reference (papers, docs, code)

Links to the primary literature or vendor docs that define the behavior
we'd be implementing.

## Existing alternatives

Is there already a Python package that does this? If so, why a new one?

## Author

Are you planning to author and maintain it?
